text:
maria.pm: Quick note from pilot calls: biggest asks = small starter SKU (~$200/mo), prepaid burst packs, and an eventual paid priority lane.

leah.sales: Echo from field. Smaller SKU shortens POC; customers prefer buying burst packs over upgrading.

akshay.eng: Tech take: prepaid packs = token-meter + billing hook (~3 sprints). Priority lane needs routing changes (separate project).

omar.finance: Recommend 3 pack sizes (50k/200k/1M). Need margin model but target ~30% gross.

katie.legal: Legal ok with starter and prepaid as long as credits expire (30d) and are non-refundable; priority lane requires SLA appendix.

maria.pm: Proposal: Phase 1 = starter SKU + prepaid burst packs (deliver with minimal runtime changes). Launch criteria: 3 pilot commitments OR projected ARR >= $25k/mo + legal addendum.

akshay.eng: I'll scope minimal path: sprint1 API + billing, sprint2 console view, sprint3 hardening. Posting scope doc EOD.

maria.pm: Vote?

leah.sales: GTM approves.

omar.finance: Finance approves contingent on modeled margins.

katie.legal: Legal approves contingent on addendum draft.

marvin-bot: files: survey-results.csv, pricing-model.xlsx uploaded to shared drive.
